notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access
notes.content:
Before release I decided to play test the game with a bunch of people. Over 50 people actively played the game and provided feedback. Here is a list of things fixed in the latest update.

-Bug fixes (Glitch into ground & not being able to jump glitch)
-Level 6 cheat
-Faster re-spawn time. From 1 second to 0.5 seconds (and 0.4 in level 10)
-Improved level 10 to make it even more Impossible
-Fixed level select screen

Only a few more days before Impossible Runner is released! I hope you are ready.
